A ring of conflict lets the ice vortex move while it engulfs the hero (monmove.c dochug() 882-887, m_move() 1858-1859). postmov() then moves the hero with it and calls swallowed(0) (monmove.c 1649-1654), which shows GLYPH_UNEXPLORED on the old 3x3 stomach (display.c 1343-1347); flush_screen() prints the cells the new stomach does not cover with the S_unexplored symbol.
